Speed Weekend Årsunda 2023

Event
The event for those who love wide stances and speed!
Bidders HighwayFebruary 28, 2023 16:05
Hello readers!

Every year, in the depths of winter, car and motorcycle enthusiasts gather in the small town of Årsunda for a unique event - Speed Weekend Årsunda. This adrenaline-fuelled event gives participants the chance to drive their vehicles on a frozen lake and push them to their limits on two ploughed tracks and a straight for top speed.

Bidders Highway was a sponsor this year and we drove up together with our own cars to participate and get to know lots of new like-minded enthusiasts.

A fantastic experience that combines the thrill of speed with the beauty of nature. Whether you're a professional driver or just a fan of motorsport, we strongly recommend planning a visit next year.

We have published photos and videos from the event on our Instagram, feel free to take a look and follow us if you don't already!

/The Bidders Highway Team
